source: The `holidays` library's India calendar (national + state gazetted holidays). Dates are produced by the library - not hand-entered.
country_context: India - national civic holidays + a sample of state calendars (TN, KL, KA, MH, WB, GJ, DL, UP) covering the major regional festivals (Pongal, Onam, Ugadi, Ganesh Chaturthi, Durga Puja, Navratri).
license: MIT (library). Underlying holiday facts are public government notifications.
citation: Vacanza et al. holidays: generate and work with holidays in Python. https://github.com/vacanza/holidays (India calendar).
preprocessing: ml/preprocessing/india_festival_adapter.py: national + 8-state union; festival_type classification by name; offline distance-to-festival features
known_limitations: Lunar-calendar festival dates for future years follow the library's projection; verify against the official gazette before relying on far-future dates.
State coverage is a curated sample of 8 states, not all 28+8.
Context only - must never be joined into SME-private datasets in a way that blurs provenance.
paper_usage: Optional exogenous seasonality feature for the Indian forecasting evaluation; label as INDIA_PUBLIC_CONTEXT. Not a target; not evidence of causality.
